question_answered: The current union-R coverage asymmetry is decomposed into route-corridor and future-path-conflict-actor support across all strict clean-off, non-held-out raw assets.

verification_scope: all component counts equal their frame lists
union equals route-support union actor-support in every view/frame
route-only actor-only and route-and-actor are an exact partition
formal dev and locked-test identities are absent

specific_findings.route202: Its nine CAM_FRONT_RIGHT union-positive frames are all route-only; it contributes zero CAM_FRONT_RIGHT actor-support frames and cannot repair conflict-actor binding.
specific_findings.front_dominance: The raw union label's front volume is dominated by 951 front route-only frame-view positives, while rear and rear-left positives are entirely actor-grounded.
specific_findings.side_route_actor_cooccurrence: Only one front-left and one front-right frame-view positive contain route and actor support together; combined support cannot be evaluated as a well-covered side-view class.

supported: The current R union target combines two differently distributed supervision problems.
Front dominance is substantially a route-corridor supervision effect, not evidence that all side/rear actor geometry is absent.
Front-right actor grounding has only four route identities and back-right has none in the exact inventory.
A universal six-view or CAM_BACK_RIGHT release gate is not identifiable from the current frozen route inventory.
not_supported: The Stage2L failure is caused only by missing CAM_BACK_RIGHT data.
Adding one custom rear-right route would validate held-out task relevance.
A union-R metric demonstrates separate route and conflict-actor binding.
The weak geometry target is semantically complete or causally correct.

decision.next_executable_work: Freeze and CPU-audit a factorized R supervision/interface that exposes route-corridor and conflict-actor components separately, reports per-event/per-view component metrics, preserves their union only as a derived diagnostic, and states an explicit unsupported-view claim boundary. Do not add GPU epochs or a new route before that audit.

claim_boundary: This result diagnoses the composition and coverage of weak privileged geometry labels. It neither validates semantic task relevance nor establishes U correctness, VLM understanding, planning benefit, closed-loop safety or benchmark generalization.
